summary: Customer inquired about tracking an RTGS transfer and received assistance.

intents.keywords: I setup RTGS transfers and it's so easy just...how to track them

issues.issue: Customer wants to track the RTGS transfer.
issues.reason(s): Customer wants to confirm the transfer went through.

intents.actions of agent: Agent asked for the transaction reference number and confirmed the transfer was completed. Agent offered to send a statement.
intents.resolution: Agent confirmed the transfer was completed and offered to send a statement, which the customer accepted.
